rationale: B better matches the reactive contract by deferring callbacks until propagation has reached a stable state and comparing each cell’s final value with its value before the update. A recomputes in dependency order, but invokes callbacks during propagation, so a callback can observe unrelated or downstream cells before the whole system is stable. B may recompute shared descendants more than once in a diamond-shaped graph, but its worklist remains clear and converges correctly for an acyclic dependency graph while emitting at most one final change notification per affected cell.
